name: 09-05-process-knowledge-base
title: Process knowledge base
description: Descoped. The original PRD proposed a bundled-JSON knowledge base of common macOS processes so the user could hover a process row and see what it does. The repo's no-network-requests rule, third-party-free stance, and locale-table existing coverage make the feature not worth the maintenance burden. See design.md for the decision and a sketch of what a future implementation would look like if constraints change.
creator: FlowTrace Research
notes: Retrospectively decided descoped on 2026-09-21. No code was ever written. The PRD is preserved as a record of intent; design.md explains the descoping decision; implement.md gives a forward sketch if constraints change. The task stays in `planning` to keep it visible — future contributors can pick it up if `AGENTS.md` is amended.

meta.status_reason: Constraints rule out every viable implementation shape; see design.md § Why no implementation.
